tools.description: Explore a chosen model's capabilities, limits, definition, defaults, accelerator profiles, presets, user settings and LoRAs.

tools.name: wangp_io
tools.description: Navigate authorized folders, search files or text, read/edit documents, save reusable skills, manage archives, and inspect physical metadata. Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

tools.name: wangp_toolbox
tools.description: Inspect or compare media, transcribe, extract, trim, assemble and transform media, or retrieve their generation settings. wait=false runs a slow action (transcription, 3D views, masks) in the background and returns a job_id for wangp_session get_job / wait_jobs. Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

agent_context.description: Context returned by wangp_workspace; reuse after reconnecting or for separate logical agents.

tools.name: wangp_validate
tools.description: CPU-only preflight without submitting, downloading or loading models. Supply settings (one generation or batch), OR media + process + parameters for a processor. Summary returns requested size/duration, grid-adjusted canvas and initial dimensions for simple inputs, the window_plan of sliding-window videos (each window's generated_seconds), adjustments, inputs, diagnostics, availability and queue counts. Initial dimensions precede optional upscaling; complex input sizing is marked unresolved. Requested values are not predictions of final output geometry or cumulative duration. detail='full' only adds every effective setting and its origin (about 10 KB per task). valid does not guarantee runtime memory or model-specific inference checks. Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

agent_context.description: Context returned by wangp_workspace; reuse after reconnecting or for separate logical agents.

tools.name: wangp_generate
tools.description: Generate image, video, audio or 3D assets. settings is one flat WanGP settings object, or a list of them for a batch submitted together in order. Each object needs model_type and the complete prompt; other WanGP settings go beside them, only custom_settings holds nested values, and media go directly in fields such as image_start or audio_guide. Template and media settings can be copied and edited. edit_* post-processing tasks need no model or prompt. A prompt may be @file("@documents/prompt.txt"): WanGP reads and snapshots that authorized UTF-8 file, preserving blank lines. Omitted resolution, video_length or duration_seconds, and seed use Deepy's standing defaults before model factory settings; supplied values are preserved. wait=true waits for completion; timeout_s bounds waiting without cancelling the job. wait=false returns a job for asynchronous tracking. Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

template.description: Optional template to start from: "<task>" (such as "gen_video") for its configured default, or "<task>/<template name>". WanGP fills in its settings except its example prompt and alt_prompt; give only the keys you change.

model_type.description: WanGP model type (from the template when one is named).

request_id.description: Optional retry key: the same key and payload returns the original job, even after a restart; a different payload is rejected.

Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

tools.name: wangp_workspace
tools.description: Agent workspaces: current returns/resumes your assignment; list queries the workspaces you may use (your own, and the user's unless the user restricted it); create starts an independent context (storage_mode: dedicated keeps its media in its own folder, shared in the common output folders; the configured default otherwise); attach creates a context for an existing workspace_id. Pass the returned agent_context on media, IO, job and session calls, especially after reconnecting or when multiplexing agents. Current shared-user permissions permit discovery/attachment; per-user visibility and cancellation rights are not implemented.

note: Schema snapshot only; perform runtime discovery. No sessions or user contexts included.
